def mirror(s):
    # s: list of (char, state) where state 'n' normal; mirror reverses order and toggles horizontal flip
    return [(c, 'h' if st=='n' else 'n') for c,st in reversed(s)]

src=[(c,'n') for c in "6k4Rp2"]
m=mirror(src)
opts={"A":[("2","h"),("p","h"),("R","n"),("4","h"),("k","h"),("6","h")],
      "B":[("2","h"),("p","h"),("R","h"),("4","v"),("k","v"),("6","h")],
      "C":[("2","h"),("p","h"),("R","h"),("4","h"),("k","h"),("6","h")],
      "D":[("p","n"),("2","n"),("R","h"),("4","h"),("k","h"),("6","h")]}
assert m==opts["C"]
for k in "ABD": assert m!=opts[k]
